item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Tuscan Ribollita – A thick, rustic and hearty Italian vegetable stew with white beans, chopped tomatoes, pointed cabbage and root vegetables, seasoned with garlic and thyme. Served piping hot with crisp garlic croutons and a sprinkle of grated hard cheese. (1+6+10+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Mexican Chilaquiles Verdes – Crisp tortilla chips tossed in a tangy green tomatillo sauce, topped with crumbled cheese and sour cream. Served with spiced black beans and fluffy rice. (6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: GREEN DISH: Nepalese noodle soup (Thukpa) with potatoes and chickpeas – full of warmth, a Nepalese hug. (1+2+4+7+8+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Pasta with lentil bolognese. (1+10+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Warm, fluffy and crisp-fried Indian flatbreads (puris) served with a mild, aromatic potato curry (bhaji) seasoned with turmeric, mustard seeds and fresh coriander. Served with mint raita, mango chutney and Indian pickles. (1+6+11+15)
